children: forcefully denied rumors circulating in some quarters that the project may shut down.
BlockBeats and other outlets reported on October 3 that Aptos CEO Avery Ching addressed the claims in a post on X. He called the shutdown speculation a "baseless rumor."
Posts on social media that day had suggested Aptos could halt blockchain operations within the next six months.
A review of Aptos's public materials found no plan to suspend operation of its mainnet.

title: Aptos Rejects Shutdown Rumors as "Baseless"
